title: TEA 2025 Annual Report / release
use: Statewide public-school context and annual-report entry point.
limits: Use underlying TAPR/PEIMS sources for exact district/campus values.

title: 2024–25 Texas Academic Performance Reports
use: Student, staff, program and demographic information for the state, districts and campuses.
limits: Annual reporting; data may lag current operating conditions.

title: Educator Reports and Data
use: Educator demographics, uncertified-teacher, retention, attrition/new-hire and related dashboards/files.
limits: Individual products have different reference periods and update dates.

title: Employed and Certified Teachers by Preparation Route 2024–25
use: Counts and percentages of employed teachers by initial preparation route/certificate status.
limits: Statewide historical table; certificate categories are not measures of teaching quality.

title: Teacher Shortage Areas 2026–27
use: Declared and critical shortage areas.
limits: Does not identify a current vacancy at a specific campus or district.

title: Teacher Vacancy Collection FAQ / implementation
use: Implementation timing and scope of the new TSDS Teacher Vacancy Collection.
limits: First annual statewide submission is due September 2027.

title: House Bill 2 implementation hub
use: Official TEA implementation guidance for compensation, certification, special education, literacy/numeracy and other HB 2 provisions.
limits: Implementation guidance changes; verify article-specific correspondence and effective dates.

title: HB 2: Teacher Retention Allotment and Support Staff Retention Allotment
use: Teacher/support-staff retention-allotment implementation details.
limits: 2025–26 implementation guidance; confirm later TEA updates.

title: Preparing and Retaining Educators through Partnerships (PREP) Allotment
use: Grow Your Own, mentorship, residency, traditional and alternative-certification partnership structures.
limits: Funding cycles, LASO windows and eligibility change over time.

title: Financial Aid for Swift Transfer (FAST)
use: Dual-credit eligibility, participating-institution funding and no-cost conditions for eligible students.
limits: Verify current institutional participation and fiscal-year rates.

title: Fall Enrollment at Texas Colleges and Universities Sets Record
use: Preliminary Fall 2025 higher-education enrollment totals.
limits: Preliminary at publication; later certified figures may supersede.

title: Programs of Study
use: 2026 Texas career clusters and Programs of Study framework.
limits: Local offerings and advisory arrangements vary.

title: Labor Market & Career Information
use: Labor-market, career, workforce and training exploration.
limits: Products differ in methodology and refresh cycle; current openings and projections must remain distinct.

title: State Training Inventory
use: Training programs/providers by region and field.
limits: Completeness and program status vary; confirm with provider.

title: Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics
use: Employment and wage estimates by occupation/geography.
limits: Survey estimates; not a live job-opening feed.

title: National Center for Education Statistics
use: Federal education datasets and institutional statistics.
limits: Release lag and definitions vary by dataset.

title: Apprenticeship Job Finder
use: Registered apprenticeship opportunity discovery.
limits: Verify individual listing status, sponsor, eligibility and location.

title: WebLLM documentation
use: Browser-local LLM inference through WebGPU, model caching and OpenAI-compatible chat APIs.
limits: Requires compatible browser/hardware; model download can be large and first-run latency significant.

title: Texas Broadband Development Maps
use: Texas broadband availability, FCC map/challenge context and links to the Texas BEAD award map.
limits: Availability maps depend on provider/FCC data and are periodically updated; map coverage is not the same as affordability, adoption or experienced performance.

title: Texas Broadband Equity, Access, and Deployment (BEAD) Program
use: Official Texas BEAD status, approved final proposal, award information, coverage and deployment context.
limits: Awards and project construction status can change as grant agreements and deployments progress; verify the award map for location-specific status.

title: Texas BEAD Application Challenge Process
use: Documents the 2025 application challenge process and links to application/project-location data.
limits: The referenced challenge window is historical; use the main BEAD page/map for current deployment status.

title: Bringing Online Opportunities to Texas (BOOT)
use: Official BOOT I award totals, location counts and monthly project-completion status file.
limits: Project-level completion should be checked in the current BOOT I awardee file; program totals do not prove service at a particular address.

title: Texas E-rate Program
use: Current E-rate program guidance, deadlines, eligible-services links and Texas connectivity support context.
limits: USAC/FCC deadlines and eligible-services rules change by funding year; verify before filing.

title: 2026 Texas State Match Fund for E-rate
use: FY2026 Texas State Match Fund eligibility and state/federal special-construction matching context.
limits: Program eligibility and available state match are funding-year specific.

title: FCC National Broadband Map — Texas BDO guidance
use: Location-level broadband availability and challenge pathways.
limits: Provider-reported availability can be challenged and should not be treated as measured household adoption or actual speed.

title: ACS 2024 Internet Subscriptions in Household (B28011)
jurisdiction: United States / state and local geographies
use: Household internet-subscription estimates for digital-access analysis.
limits: Survey estimate with sampling error; subscription is not identical to broadband availability, affordability, reliability or school-device access.

title: Texas State Library — Broadband Resources
publisher: Texas State Library and Archives Commission
use: Public-library broadband assessment, E-rate and digital-access resources.
limits: Resource/navigation page; project availability and funding status require source-specific verification.

title: Library Infrastructure Facility Improvement (LIFI) Grant
publisher: Texas State Library and Archives Commission
use: Library broadband/facility improvements supporting education, work and health-monitoring access, including connectivity and privacy-space uses.
limits: Funding windows and awards vary by fiscal year; verify the current NOFO and award notices.

title: Privacy Booths in Libraries: A Quiet Revolution
publisher: Texas State Library and Archives Commission
use: Institutional examples of library privacy booths/study rooms used for telehealth, job interviews and other private broadband-enabled services.
limits: Program examples, not a statewide utilization estimate.

title: Texas HHS Clinical Guidelines — Telemedicine
use: Current program guidance indicating telemedicine may be used when appropriate with consent, confidentiality, quality and supervision safeguards.
limits: Program-specific clinical guidance; not a universal statement of every Texas telehealth rule or payer requirement.

title: Texas Virtual and Hybrid Education
use: Current Texas virtual/hybrid education framework and implementation resources under Chapter 30B.
limits: Authorization, rulemaking and program timelines are changing; use the current TEA page for decisions.

title: Trystero 0.25.3 / 0.25.x API
use: Serverless WebRTC peer discovery, object-based actions, optional SDP password encryption and TURN configuration.
limits: Public discovery networks and direct WebRTC are external dependencies; restrictive NAT/firewall conditions can require TURN.

title: WebLLM — Dedicated Web Worker usage
use: Browser-local LLM inference with computation offloaded to a dedicated Web Worker.
limits: Requires WebGPU-compatible hardware/browser; models are large and must be downloaded/cached before offline use.
